causebase_summary: South Australian Rainbow Advocacy Alliance Inc. (SARAA) is a South Australia‑based peak body that advocates for LGBTIQA+ people across the state. As of the cited sources it runs policy advocacy and submissions (for example on births, deaths and marriages regulations), correspondence with health authorities about gender‑affirming care, and public events and commemorations such as Trans Day of Visibility and youth forums. SARAA provides online resources including a “Know Your Rights” guide, operates a Rainbow Local Council Project to support local government inclusion, and recruits members and sells branded merchandise. Recent activity listed on the organisation’s site includes submissions, letters to government, event listings and involvement in demographic question reviews for the state Department of Health and Wellbeing.

data.SummaryOfActivities: We undertook systemic advocacy, providing expert advice, community consultation and policy analysis to make structural social change to policies and practices that improves the quality of life for LGBTIQA+ South Australians.   Our wins included advocating for a legislative ban on conversion practices, recruiting our inaugural CEO, supporting vulnerable LGBTIQA+ people to engage with the media to share their stories, connecting with South Australian councils through the Rainbow Council Network and representing LGBTIQA+ communities on key advisory bodies.  We built the capacity of LGBTIQA+ communities to actively participate in public life by providing opportunities for networking and connection. We supported LGBTIQA+ South Australians through the delivery of suicide prevention training, hosted events at Feast Festival, and were recognised for our work as winners of the South Australian Pride Awards  Sports Health and Wellbeing Award
